title: Finite nilpotent exponential: bounds, inverse, maps and commuting sums
statement:
Let $A$ and $B$ be unital associative rings equipped with central unital maps $\mathbf Q\to A$ and $\mathbf Q\to B$. An element $a\in A$ is nilpotent if $a^N=0$ for some integer $N\geq1$. For nilpotent $a$, the element
$$E_A(a)=\sum_{j=0}^{N-1}\frac{a^j}{j!}$$
is independent of the chosen bound $N$ with $a^N=0$. It satisfies
$$E_A(a)E_A(-a)=1=E_A(-a)E_A(a).$$
For every unital ring homomorphism $\phi:A\to B$ and nilpotent $a\in A$, one has
$$\phi(E_A(a))=E_B(\phi(a)).$$
For nilpotent $a,b,a+b\in A$ with $ab=ba$, one has
$$E_A(a+b)=E_A(a)E_A(b).$$
The statement includes matrix rings [def-weil-matrix] and rings of endomorphisms of finite free modules over any commutative $\mathbf Q$-algebra, including the zero ring.
